title: Markdown content negotiation
question: Can an agent ask for a product page as Markdown?
method: GET a sampled product page with Accept: text/markdown. Pass when the response is text/markdown with the product title in the body; fail when HTML comes back.

title: Server-rendered product content
question: Are title, price and description present in the raw HTML without JavaScript?
method: Parse the raw HTML of sampled product pages. Pass when a title, a price-like value and a description are present as text or structured data; fail when the body is an empty app shell.

title: Page weight and response time
question: Is a product page cheap enough for an agent to fetch?
method: Measure HTML size and time to first byte on sampled product pages. Pass under 500 KB and 1.5 s; warn under 1 MB and 3 s; fail above.

title: Canonical and hreflang present
question: Can an agent tell which URL is the product's canonical one?
method: Pass when sampled product pages carry a rel=canonical that resolves to the same origin; warn when hreflang alternates exist for some but not all detected languages.

title: Accessible main content
question: Is the product content inside a main landmark and not hidden behind an overlay in the HTML?
method: Pass when a main or article landmark wraps the product content; warn when a consent overlay appears to wrap or precede it in the DOM.
